conclusion: Withdraw the claim that December AD300 conflicts with next first month / March AD300. I conflated the conventional Western-year label for lunar Yuankang9 (299) with the Western dates of its twelfth month. The actual approved audit a081 explicitly checked this month conversion. No error in the four owned AD300 values is established; no repair or new audit is warranted by this QA allegation.

actualAudit.summary: Owned units, claims, hints, and people were checked against the Chinese chapter, not the English rendering. Stated ages (five sui undated; twenty-three sui at death) are preserved, and no birth year was inferred from them. Hui’s accession, Yuankang 1, Yongkang 1, Yongning 1, and Tai’an 1 convert to AD 290, 291, 300, 301, and 302. The twelfth month after 九年六月 is Yuankang 9/12, which the calendar tables place entirely in AD 300 (month begins 300-01-08), so those deposition dates are not the conventional 299 reign-year label. Empty hints on undated and retrospective figures were left empty. Posthumous 追封/追諡 remain reception and do not feed extra activity years. Competing annals readings (burial 己卯 versus 壬寅; Shang’s heirship August versus May) stay same-year witnesses. No owned check is unsupported.

relevantItemChecks.event: Empress Jia lured Sima Yu to court in order to depose him in the twelfth month.
relevantItemChecks.reason: s0045’s 十二月 follows 九年六月 in the Yuankang sequence; that twelfth month falls in AD 300.

relevantItemChecks.event: Empress Jia staged a false confession against Sima Yu in the following first month.
relevantItemChecks.reason: s0066 明年正月 is the first month after Yuankang 9, i.e. Yongkang 1, AD 300.

relevantItemChecks.event: A forged edict sent Sun Lü to Xuchang to kill Sima Yu in the third month.
relevantItemChecks.reason: s0120’s 三月 continues the Yongkang 1 narrative after 明年正月, so the year is AD 300.

relevantItemChecks.event: Sima Yu was degraded to commoner in the twelfth month.
relevantItemChecks.reason: s0062–s0063 complete the s0045 twelfth-month deposition; that month is AD 300.

relevantItemChecks.event: Yu was first sentenced to death, then degraded to commoner, in the twelfth month.
relevantItemChecks.reason: s0058’s 賜死 and s0062’s 免為庶人 are the same twelfth-month sitting, AD 300.

relevantItemChecks.event: Sima Yu was deposed as victim of Empress Jia’s twelfth-month plot.
relevantItemChecks.reason: s0045–s0063 narrate Yu’s own deposition in that twelfth month, AD 300.

personChecks.reason: No birth year is stated. Ages five (undated) and twenty-three at the AD 300 murder stay sui. Dated life events run 惠帝即位, 元康元年, then 十二月/正月/三月/六月; later 諡 is not used as a life date.

calendarAndPrimaryReferences.title: 晉書/卷004
calendarAndPrimaryReferences.quote: 十二月壬戌，廢皇太子遹爲庶人
calendarAndPrimaryReferences.reason: Annals confirm the chapter’s twelfth-month deposition as Yuankang 9/12, day renxu.

calendarAndPrimaryReferences.title: 晉書/卷004
calendarAndPrimaryReferences.quote: 癸未，賈后矯詔害庶人遹于許昌
calendarAndPrimaryReferences.reason: Annals give a guiwei day inside Yongkang 1/3 for Yu’s murder; the chapter’s 三月 year is still AD 300.

calendarAndPrimaryReferences.title: 元康 (西晋)
calendarAndPrimaryReferences.quote: 元康十年（300年）正月一日，改元為永康元年。
calendarAndPrimaryReferences.reason: Yuankang ends at New Year AD 300. The same page’s month table starts 元康九年十二月 on 300/1/8, so the chapter’s 十二月 events are AD 300, not the conventional 299 reign-year label. Western year-level values here do not flip between Julian and proleptic Gregorian.

calendarAndPrimaryReferences.title: 永康 (西晋)
calendarAndPrimaryReferences.quote: 永康（ 300年—301年四月）是西晋皇帝晋惠帝司马衷的第四个年号。
calendarAndPrimaryReferences.reason: Yongkang 1 is AD 300. The page table places 正月 on 2/7, 三月 on 4/6, and 六月 on 7/3, all inside AD 300, supporting 明年正月, the March murder, and the sixth-month burial.

calendarAndPrimaryReferences.title: 太安 (西晋)
calendarAndPrimaryReferences.quote: 永寧二年（302年）十二月二十二日，改元為太安元年。
calendarAndPrimaryReferences.reason: Tai’an was proclaimed in the twelfth month of Yongning 2, but Jin Shu headings treat 太安元年 as the civil year AD 302, so 太安元年三月 and 太安初 stay AD 302.

calendarAndPrimaryReferences.title: 中央研究院 兩千年中西曆轉換
calendarAndPrimaryReferences.quote: 在此之前的西曆稱為儒略(Julian)曆
calendarAndPrimaryReferences.reason: Academia Sinica defaults to Julian before 1582-10-15. For these AD 290–302 months the Western year is the same under that default and proleptic Gregorian; claims here use year precision, not a converted day.

primarySourceRelevantUnits.zh: 九年六月，有桑生於宮西廂，日長尺餘，數日而枯。
十二月，賈后將廢太子，詐稱上不和，呼太子入朝。
帝幸式乾殿，召公卿入，使黃門令董猛乙太子書及青紙詔曰：「遹書如此，今賜死。」
後懼事變，乃表免太子為庶人，詔許之。
於是使尚書和郁持節，解結為副，及大將軍梁王肜、鎮東將軍淮南王允、前將軍東武公澹、趙王倫、太保何劭詣東宮，廢太子為庶人。
明年正月，賈后又使黃門自首，欲與太子為逆。
三月，矯詔使黃門孫慮齋至許昌以害太子。

conversionScope: Existing audit’s cited month table begins Yuankang9/12 at Western300-01-08 and Yongkang1/1 at300-02-07; this addendum reports and reconciles that already-approved evidence, not a new independent calendar/date approval. Its primary Jin004 annals witness is consistent with lunar succession across the Western-year boundary.
remainingOutsideQA: Other separately typed findings remain unchanged; this retraction is only the specified four-claim December allegation.
